findings.title: No tests for the new fallback behavior
findings.body: The PR introduces a new FallbackLocaleList class, a custom I18n.fallbacks implementation, the new I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! method, and a new I18n.ensure_loaded! method on the freedom patch. None of these changes have accompanying specs. There is no coverage verifying: that the fallback chain order is correct for users vs anonymous requests, that I18n.locale changes between requests trigger reloads, that SiteSetting.default_locale is honored as a fallback, that missing keys in a non-English locale correctly fall back to English, or that ensure_loaded! is idempotent. The PR description 'Test 9' does not indicate tests are present anywhere.

findings.title: FallbackLocaleList inherits Hash but only overrides []
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList < Hash redefines only the [] method. All other methods of I18n::Locale::Fallbacks that callers may rely on (e.g. defaults, defaults=, compute, map, each over configured fallbacks, []=) are left as plain Hash methods that operate on an always-empty Hash. Any plugin or piece of code that does I18n.fallbacks[:zh_TW] = [:zh_TW, :zh_CN, :en] will silently be ignored because lookup always goes through the overridden []. Methods like I18n.fallbacks.defaults will raise NoMethodError. Either stop inheriting Hash or implement the full Locale::Fallbacks contract so that per-locale configuration and other API consumers are not broken.

findings.title: Fallback chain mixes String and Symbol locales
findings.body: set_locale in application_controller.rb assigns I18n.locale from current_user.effective_locale or SiteSetting.default_locale, which return String values in Discourse. The fallback chain is [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en], so the chain can contain a String like 'fr' alongside Symbols :en. Array#uniq does not deduplicate values of different types, so 'en' and :en would both end up in the chain and load_locale would add both to @loaded_locales in translate_accelerator.rb. This results in wasted reloads and risks comparison surprises in i18n internals or third-party code. Coerce locale to a Symbol (e.g. locale.to_sym) so the chain is uniformly typed.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! has a data race on @loaded_locales
findings.body: ensure_loaded! initializes @loaded_locales ||= [] outside any mutex and then calls load_locale, which itself protects only the body via LOAD_MUTEX. Two threads that race on the first call can each observe @loaded_locales as nil, create separate Array instances, and the last write wins. Whichever instance is no longer referenced loses its additions, so subsequent calls into ensure_loaded!/load_locale can re-load already-loaded locales. The mutex currently held only by load_locale is not sufficient because @loaded_locales may flip between two arrays mid-flight. Initialize the ivar under the same LOAD_MUTEX (or use a Set guarded by the mutex) so the @loaded_locales reference itself is stable.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! allocates per request in a before_filter
findings.body: set_locale runs as a before_filter on every request, and the new line invokes I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!, which calls self[I18n.locale] and allocates a new Array every time, then iterates it calling I18n.ensure_loaded! for each fallback locale. The actual YAML loading is memoized via @loaded_locales, but the per-request Array allocation and Hash#[] invocation occur for every request, including API and XHR requests that never render translations. Consider calling ensure_loaded! only when the locale or SiteSetting.default_locale changes, or memoizing the resolved fallback chain on the FallbackLocaleList instance.

findings.title: Fallback config silently moved without explanation
findings.body: The PR removes config.i18n.fallbacks = true (and its explanatory comment) from config/environments/production.rb, config/environments/profile.rb, and config/cloud/cloud66/files/production.rb without leaving a comment noting that i18n fallbacks are now configured exclusively by config/initializers/i18n.rb. The two places previously disagreed in subtle ways and a future engineer may add the Rails-style line back, double-enabling the Fallbacks module, or assume the initializer is the only source of truth. Leave a one-line note in each environment file pointing at the initializer, or document the migration in the initializer itself.
